name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk automatically matches development requests and compiles them into executable RequirementContract 1.2 handoffs, with an optional repository strict mode for per-message preflight enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Compile development requests with optional strict mode
interface.longDescription: AI Talk automatically matches development work without requiring a command prefix, then releases status updates unchanged or compiles actionable work into RequirementContract 1.2. Repository strict mode installs a managed AGENTS.md rule so every development message explicitly runs the preflight once. Only blockers that change the product result or writable scope are held for one decisive question, and downstream execution never loops back through AI Talk.
capabilities: Transparent pass-through for status and confirmation messages
Stable selector and DOM fingerprint capture
Entry point and control point separation
Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
